note: Shared by packages/alpha-tab-kit/test/digest.test.mjs and src/mcp/tools/alpha_tab_kit_drift.rs: both compute each expected value independently.

needs.label: Your person record and account ID, from your own account binding
needs.sql: SELECT r.id, r.name, b.identifier AS account FROM bindings b JOIN records r ON r.id = b.record_id WHERE b.system = 'account' ORDER BY b.is_canonical DESC, r.id LIMIT 1

needs.label: Last 800 events grouped by agent run and record (200 newest groups), with record type, status and folder
needs.sql: SELECT g.run_key, g.record_id, g.actor, g.events, g.created, g.links, g.facets, g.first_seq, g.last_seq, g.first_at, g.last_at, r.type, r.kind, r.name, r.lifecycle, r.home_id, h.name AS home_name, h.kind AS home_kind, (SELECT l.target_id FROM links l WHERE l.source_id = r.id AND l.relationship = 'part_of' ORDER BY l.target_id LIMIT 1) AS part_of_id FROM (SELECT x.run_key, x.record_id, MAX(x.actor) AS actor, COUNT(*) AS events, SUM(CASE WHEN x.type = 'record.created' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS created, SUM(CASE WHEN x.type LIKE 'link.%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS links, SUM(CASE WHEN x.type LIKE 'facet.%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS facets, MIN(x.local_seq) AS first_seq, MAX(x.local_seq) AS last_seq, MIN(x.created_at) AS first_at, MAX(x.created_at) AS last_at FROM (SELECT e.local_seq, e.run_key, e.record_id, e.type, e.actor, e.created_at FROM content_events e ORDER BY e.local_seq DESC LIMIT 800) x GROUP BY x.run_key, x.record_id) g JOIN records r ON r.id = g.record_id LEFT JOIN records h ON h.id = r.home_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY g.last_seq DESC LIMIT 200

needs.label: 200 newest comments you can see: title, first 360 characters, author run, and the record each is on
needs.sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, substr(c.body, 1, 360) AS preview, c.created_at, (SELECT e.actor FROM content_events e WHERE e.record_id = c.id ORDER BY e.local_seq LIMIT 1) AS actor, (SELECT e.run_key FROM content_events e WHERE e.record_id = c.id ORDER BY e.local_seq LIMIT 1) AS run_key, t.id AS target_id, t.type AS target_type, t.kind AS target_kind, t.name AS target_name, t.lifecycle AS target_lifecycle, t.home_id AS target_home_id, (SELECT h.name FROM records h WHERE h.id = t.home_id) AS target_home_name FROM records c JOIN links l ON l.source_id = c.id AND l.relationship = 'part_of' JOIN records t ON t.id = l.target_id WHERE c.type = 'Annotation' AND c.kind = 'comment' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id LIMIT 200

needs.label: Up to 200 messages you sent or that are addressed to you, first 360 characters each; others' messages excluded
needs.sql: SELECT m.id, m.name, substr(m.body, 1, 360) AS preview, m.created_at, (SELECT e.actor FROM content_events e WHERE e.record_id = m.id ORDER BY e.local_seq LIMIT 1) AS actor, (SELECT e.run_key FROM content_events e WHERE e.record_id = m.id ORDER BY e.local_seq LIMIT 1) AS run_key, (SELECT f.value FROM facet_values f WHERE f.record_id = m.id AND f.key = 'expectation') AS expectation, (SELECT l.target_id FROM links l WHERE l.source_id = m.id AND l.relationship = 'addressed_to' ORDER BY l.target_id LIMIT 1) AS to_id, (SELECT p.name FROM links l JOIN records p ON p.id = l.target_id WHERE l.source_id = m.id AND l.relationship = 'addressed_to' ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 1) AS to_name, (SELECT l.target_id FROM links l WHERE l.source_id = m.id AND l.relationship = 'reply_to' ORDER BY l.target_id LIMIT 1) AS reply_to_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages_awaiting_reply w WHERE w.message_id = m.id) AS awaiting, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_events e WHERE e.record_id = m.id AND e.type = 'message.reaction.added.v1') - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_events e WHERE e.record_id = m.id AND e.type = 'message.reaction.removed.v1') AS reactions, CASE WHEN (SELECT e.actor FROM content_events e WHERE e.record_id = m.id ORDER BY e.local_seq LIMIT 1) IN (SELECT b.identifier FROM bindings b WHERE b.system = 'account') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS from_viewer, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM links l JOIN bindings b ON b.record_id = l.target_id AND b.system = 'account' WHERE l.source_id = m.id AND l.relationship = 'addressed_to') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS to_viewer FROM records m WHERE m.type = 'Message' AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND ((SELECT e.actor FROM content_events e WHERE e.record_id = m.id ORDER BY e.local_seq LIMIT 1) IN (SELECT b.identifier FROM bindings b WHERE b.system = 'account') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM links l JOIN bindings b ON b.record_id = l.target_id AND b.system = 'account' WHERE l.source_id = m.id AND l.relationship = 'addressed_to')) ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id LIMIT 200

needs.label: Agent runs behind those 800 events, with declared intent and presence for runs seen in the last 24 hours
needs.sql: SELECT g.run_key, g.events, g.records, g.first_at, g.last_at, (SELECT substr(a.declared_intent, 1, 280) FROM agent_activity a WHERE a.run_key = g.run_key ORDER BY a.activity_id LIMIT 1) AS intent, (SELECT a.appears_active FROM agent_activity a WHERE a.run_key = g.run_key ORDER BY a.activity_id LIMIT 1) AS appears_active, (SELECT a.started_at FROM agent_activity a WHERE a.run_key = g.run_key ORDER BY a.activity_id LIMIT 1) AS started_at, (SELECT a.last_observed_activity_at FROM agent_activity a WHERE a.run_key = g.run_key ORDER BY a.activity_id LIMIT 1) AS last_seen_at FROM (SELECT x.run_key, COUNT(*) AS events, COUNT(DISTINCT x.record_id) AS records, MIN(x.created_at) AS first_at, MAX(x.created_at) AS last_at FROM (SELECT e.local_seq, e.run_key, e.record_id, e.created_at FROM content_events e ORDER BY e.local_seq DESC LIMIT 800) x WHERE x.run_key IS NOT NULL GROUP BY x.run_key) g ORDER BY g.last_at DESC, g.run_key LIMIT 200

needs.label: Up to 50 comments on one record and replies to them, with full bodies, read when you open its thread
needs.sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.body, c.created_at, (SELECT e.actor FROM content_events e WHERE e.record_id = c.id ORDER BY e.local_seq LIMIT 1) AS actor, (SELECT e.run_key FROM content_events e WHERE e.record_id = c.id ORDER BY e.local_seq LIMIT 1) AS run_key, l.target_id AS parent_id FROM records c JOIN links l ON l.source_id = c.id AND l.relationship = 'part_of' WHERE c.type = 'Annotation' AND c.kind = 'comment' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND (l.target_id = ?1 OR l.target_id IN (SELECT l2.source_id FROM links l2 WHERE l2.target_id = ?1 AND l2.relationship = 'part_of')) ORDER BY c.created_at, c.id LIMIT 50
